questions.q: Which ancient land between the Tigris and Euphrates is called the cradle of civilisation?
questions.why: Writing was invented there.

questions.q: Which people invented cuneiform writing?
questions.why: They wrote on clay tablets.

questions.q: Which Babylonian king created a famous law code?
questions.why: It includes 'an eye for an eye'.

questions.q: Which ancient city had the legendary Hanging Gardens?
questions.why: They were a Wonder of the Ancient World.

questions.q: Which city was the capital of the Abbasid Caliphate?
questions.why: It was founded in 762.

questions.q: Which ancient poem is one of the oldest stories ever written?
questions.why: Gilgamesh was a king of Uruk.

questions.q: In which year did Iraq invade Kuwait, leading to the Gulf War?
questions.why: A US-led coalition drove Iraq out in 1991.

questions.q: Which Abbasid centre of learning in Baghdad translated Greek works?
questions.why: It was at its height in the 800s.

questions.q: Which Babylonian king built the blue-tiled Ishtar Gate?
questions.why: It now stands in a Berlin museum.

questions.q: Which Assyrian capital had a great library of clay tablets?
questions.why: King Ashurbanipal collected it.

questions.q: Which Sumerian city had a great ziggurat and royal tombs?
questions.why: It is near Nasiriyah.

questions.q: In which year did a US-led invasion topple Saddam Hussein?
questions.why: He was captured that December.

questions.q: Which king became Iraq's first monarch in 1921?
questions.why: The monarchy ended in 1958.

questions.q: Which Akkadian ruler created what is called the first empire?
questions.why: He ruled around 2300 BC.

questions.q: Which invaders sacked Baghdad in 1258?
questions.why: Hulagu Khan led them.

questions.q: What is the capital of Iraq?
questions.why: It lies on the Tigris.

questions.q: Which two great rivers flow through Iraq?
questions.why: They join to form the Shatt al-Arab.

questions.q: What is Iraq's currency?
questions.why: The Central Bank of Iraq issues it.

questions.q: Which port city is in the far south of Iraq?
questions.why: Legend makes it the home of Sinbad.

questions.q: Which southern wetlands are home to the Marsh Arabs?
questions.why: They are a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which split and fire-grilled carp is a Baghdad speciality?
questions.why: It is cooked beside an open fire.

questions.q: What is the capital of Iraq's Kurdistan Region?
questions.why: Its citadel is one of the oldest lived-in sites.

questions.q: Which holy city has the shrine of Imam Ali?
questions.why: It has one of the world's largest cemeteries.

questions.q: Which holy city has the shrine of Imam Husayn?
questions.why: Millions visit for Arbaeen.

questions.q: Which city's Great Mosque has a famous spiral minaret?
questions.why: The minaret is called the Malwiya.

questions.q: Which story collection includes Sinbad and many tales set in Baghdad?
questions.why: Harun al-Rashid appears in many tales.

questions.q: Which Iraqi-British architect designed the London Aquatics Centre?
questions.why: She won the Pritzker Prize in 2004.

questions.q: Which stringed instrument did Iraqi master Munir Bashir play?
questions.why: He was called the 'Prince of the Oud'.

questions.q: In which year did Iraq win the AFC Asian Cup?
questions.why: The win united the country in hard times.

questions.q: Which city's Al-Nuri Mosque was rebuilt after 2017?
questions.why: Its leaning minaret was called al-Hadba.
